title: Vibration RMS — Gradual Increase Detected
description: Vibration RMS P004 shows {val}% increase over last 7 days. Current value {val2} mm/s. Still within ISO Zone B (acceptable for long-term operation) but trend requires monitoring.
probable_cause: Normal bearing wear progression or loosening of machine foundation bolts.
diagnostic_steps: Compare to factory acceptance vibration record
remedy: Schedule preventive inspection at next planned maintenance. Document in maintenance log.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
escalation_path: If SPN-MN-004 is not addressed (log fault. monitor parameters. schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-SR-003, then SPN-MJ-002. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
